#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

// Number theory modulus class for 998244353
class Mod998 {
public:
    static const long long MOD = 998244353LL;
    
    vector<int> fact, invFact;
    
    Mod998() {
        fact.push_back(1);
        invFact.push_back(1);
    }
    
    long long norm(long long x) {
        x %= MOD;
        if (x < 0) x += MOD;
        return x;
    }
    
    long long add(long long a, long long b) {
        long long v = a + b;
        return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
    }
    
    long long mul(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a * b) % MOD;
    }
    
    long long mul(long long a, long long b, long long c) {
        return mul(mul(a, b), c);
    }
    
    long long mul(long long a, long long b, long long c, long long d) {
        return mul(mul(a, b), mul(c, d));
    }
    
    long long fact_(int n) {
        while ((int)fact.size() <= n) {
            fact.push_back((int)mul(fact.back(), (int)fact.size()));
        }
        return fact[n];
    }
    
    long long fInv(int n) {
        int lastKnown = (int)invFact.size() - 1;
        if (lastKnown < n) {
            int len = n - lastKnown;
            vector<long long> tmp(len);
            tmp[0] = inv(fact_(n));
            for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
                tmp[i] = mul(tmp[i-1], n - i + 1);
            }
            for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                invFact.push_back((int)tmp[i]);
            }
        }
        return invFact[n];
    }
    
    long long paritySign(long long k) {
        return (k & 1) == 0 ? 1 : MOD - 1;
    }
    
    long long ncr(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
        return mul(fact_(n), mul(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
    }
    
    long long smallInv(int n) {
        return mul(fInv(n), fact_(n - 1));
    }
    
    long long inv(long long value) {
        long long g = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
        for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
            long long q = g / r;
            g %= r;
            long long temp = g;
            g = r;
            r = temp;
            x -= q * y;
            temp = x;
            x = y;
            y = temp;
        }
        // g == 1
        return norm(x);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    
    Mod998 mod;
    mod.fInv(n + m);
    
    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = mod.mul(p, n - i, mod.smallInv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
    }
    
    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long sign = mod.paritySign(k + 1);
        long long numPhases = mod.mul(m + k, mod.smallInv(k));
        long long term = mod.mul(sign, mod.ncr(n, k), numPhases, phaseSize);
        answer = mod.add(answer, term);
    }
    
    cout << answer << "\n";
    
    return 0;
}
